461: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ; ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
When one grasps the feet of God, the Master of all treasures and spiritual powers, what anxiety can remain?
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
Everything is under the control of God, who is our Protector.
ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ. ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ; ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Holding him by the arm, God absorbs him into Himself, blesses him with His Name, places His hand upon his forehead, and saves him.
ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ; ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
The world-ocean does not afflict one who has tasted the ambrosial essence of the Lord.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ; ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
In the Company of the Holy, imbued with the Name, he wins the battle in the great arena of life.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ, ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ. ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
Prays Nanak, one who abides in the sanctuary of the Lord Master shall never again be uprooted by the Messenger of death. ॥4॥3॥12॥
ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ; ਸੋ. ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
The deeds you have done, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ; ਸੋ. ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
The One from whom you hide them sees them, and is with you.
ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ; ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
The Creator Lord is with you, and sees everything; why commit sin?
ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ; ਨਰਕਿ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
So perform good deeds and chant the Name, and you shall never have to go to hell.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ; ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Twenty-four hours a day, remember the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.
ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, vibrate on the Lord forever in the Company of the Holy, and the sins you have committed shall be erased. ॥1॥
ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ. ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ; ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Practising deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give everything to all.
ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
The Great Giver, the Lord Master, is always merciful; why should we forget Him from our minds?
ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ. ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ; ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
Join the Company of the Holy, and vibrate on Him fearlessly; all your generations shall be carried across.
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ; ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
The Siddhas, seekers, gods, silent sages and devotees all take the Name as their support.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Prays Nanak, vibrate forever on God, the One Creator Lord. ॥2॥
Do not practise deception; God is the Assayer of all.
Those who practise falsehood and deceit are reincarnated into the world.
ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Those who meditate on the One Lord cross over the world-ocean.
ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
Renouncing lust, anger and the slander of the good, they come to God's sanctuary.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His lotus feet are their only sustenance. ॥3॥
Behold the world as an illusory castle in the sky; nothing here is permanent.
ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ; ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
All the pleasures of Maya shall not go along with you.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ; ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.
ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
Without the One Lord there is nothing else; burn away the love of duality.
ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Know in your mind that the One God is your friend, your youth, your wealth, your everything.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
Prays Nanak, by great good fortune one finds the Lord, and is absorbed in peace and poise. ॥4॥4॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ, ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ; ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ, ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
Maya is a wall of doubt, Maya is a wall of doubt; its intoxication is potent and leads astray, and one's life is wasted in vain.
ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ. ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ, ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ; ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
The world is a terrible, dense forest, a terrible, dense forest; the thief of the mind plunders the home of the heart, and day after day the sun consumes one's life.
ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ, ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
The days of life are consumed and pass away without God; meet me, O God, my merciful Lord.
462: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਬੀਤੇ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਬਿਨੁ, ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
Countless births and deaths have passed; without the Beloved's company I have found no peace.
ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨੀ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ. ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
I have no good lineage, beauty, fragrance or wisdom; without You, who is my protector?
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ. ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
With palms joined, Nanak has come to Your refuge; Beloved Master, Lord, lift me up. ॥1॥
ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ. ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਹੇ; ਓਹੁ; ਬਿਛੁਰਤ. ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ; ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ, ਪ੍ਰਿਅ, ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
The fish without water, the fish without water — separated, its mind and body waste away; how can it live without its beloved?
ਸਨਮੁਖ. ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ, ਸਨਮੁਖ. ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਰਪੇ, ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੇ; ਓਹੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਤ ॥
The deer faces the arrow, faces the arrow; it gives up mind, body and life, pierced by the soothing sound it loves.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ, ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ, ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
I have fallen in love with my Beloved; meet me — my heart is detached from the world; cursed is the body that lives a moment without Him.
ਪਲਕਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ, ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ; ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ. ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
My eyelids do not close; I am wrapped in my Beloved's love; my mind thinks of God night and day.
ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ. ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ; ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਖੋਤ ॥
Those dyed in the Lord's love, intoxicated with the Name, are rid of all fear, doubt and duality.
ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
Merciful, all-pervading Lord, show me kindness and grace, so that Nanak stays absorbed in Your love. ॥2॥
ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ, ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ; ਮਕਰੰਦ; ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਤ ਹੇ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਮਲ, ਬੰਧਾਵਤ ਆਪ ॥
The bees hum, the bees hum, drunk on the nectar and fragrance; in love they bind themselves to the lotus.
ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ. ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੇ; ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਹੇ; ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ. ਬਿਨਸਤ ਤਾਪ ॥
The rainbird's heart thirsts, the rainbird's heart thirsts; it longs for the cloud's precious drop, and drinking it, its burning is quenched.
ਤਾਪਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ. ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ; ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ॥
Destroyer of burning, destroyer of pain, meet me; my mind and body hold a deep, deep love.
ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
My beautiful, wise, all-knowing Master — with what tongue can I tell Your virtues?
ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
Take me by the arm and give me Your Name; when You cast Your glance, sins are wiped away.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੰਪੈ. ਪਤਿਤ, ਪਾਵਨ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ, ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: Purifier of sinners, beholding the Lord's sight, no suffering remains. ॥3॥
ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ, ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਹੇ; ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ, ਅਨਾਥ ਹੇ; ਮਿਲੁ ਚਾਉ ਚਾਈਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
I think of my Master in my heart, I think of my Master in my heart; keep me, helpless, in Your refuge; meet me — my soul longs for You.
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ. ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੇ; ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ. ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੇ; ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ. ਰਾਖਤ ਮਾਨ ॥
My attention is fixed on Your beautiful form, fixed on Your beautiful form; my mind longs to know the Lord of the world; You keep the honour of those who beg at Your door.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ. ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ; ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
God honours His beggars and destroys their pain; all their wishes are fulfilled.
ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ. ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਹ. ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ ॥
Blessed are the days of those who are hugged close by the Lord; meeting the Husband, their bed is made beautiful.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ. ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ; ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
Those on whom God casts His glance meet the Lord, and all their sins are destroyed.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ; ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
Prays Nanak: my hope is fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the treasure of virtues. ॥4॥1॥14॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ, ਸਲੋਕ ਭੀ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ਲਿਖੇ; ਟੁੰਡੇ ਅਸ ਰਾਜੈ ਕੀ, ਧੁਨੀ ॥
The Vaar with saloks, both written by the First Guru, to be sung to the tune of Tunda As Raja.
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru a hundred times a day,
ਜਿਨਿ. ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੀਏ; ਕਰਤ. ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
who made gods out of humans without delay. ॥1॥
463: ਜੇ. ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ ਉਗਵਹਿ; ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਹਿ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
If a hundred moons rose and a thousand suns appeared,
ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਦਿਆਂ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
even with so much light, without the Guru there is pitch darkness. ॥2॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ; ਮਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
Nanak: those who do not keep the Guru in mind, thinking themselves clever,
ਛੁਟੇ ਤਿਲ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ; ਸੁੰਞੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ॥
are like stray, hollow sesame plants left behind in an empty field.
ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛੁਟਿਆ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
Left behind in the field — says Nanak — they have a hundred masters;
ਫਲੀਅਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ; ਭੀ. ਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
the poor things flower and bear fruit, yet inside they are full of ash. ॥3॥
ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓ; ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਾਉ ॥
The Lord created the Self, and brought forth the Name as well;
ਦੁਯੀ. ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਐ; ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥
then, second, made creation, and seated within it, watches with delight.
ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ. ਆਪਿ ਤੂੰ; ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ. ਕਰਹਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
You Yourself are the Giver and the Maker; pleased, You give and bless.
ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਸਭਸੈ; ਦੇ ਲੈਸਹਿ. ਜਿੰਦੁ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
You know everyone; You give life and body, and take them back.
Seated within creation, You watch with delight. ॥1॥
True are Your continents, true Your universes;
true are Your worlds, true Your forms;
true are Your deeds and all Your thoughts.
True is Your rule, true Your court;
true is Your Hukam, true Your decree;
true is Your grace, true its sign.
Millions upon millions call You true;
ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ; ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
all power and all might rest with the True One.
True is Your praise, true Your glory;
true is Your creation, O True King.
Nanak: those who meditate on the True One are true;
ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ; ਸੁ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
those caught in birth and death are utterly unripe. ॥1॥
Great is the greatness, for great is the Name;
great is the greatness, for true is the justice;
great is the greatness, for the seat is unshakeable;
great is the greatness: every prayer is known;
great is the greatness: every feeling is understood;
ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜਾ. ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
great is the greatness: giving without asking anyone's advice;
great is the greatness: there is no one else like the Lord.
Nanak: the workings of creation cannot be described;
all that is made was made by the Lord's will. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ, ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ; ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
This world is the dwelling of the True One; the True One lives within it.
ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ; ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
By the Hukam some are merged into the Lord; by the Hukam some are destroyed.
ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ; ਇਕਨੑਾ. ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
By the Lord's will some are lifted out of Maya; others are left to dwell in it.
ਏਵ ਭਿ. ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ; ਜਿ ਕਿਸੈ. ਆਣੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
No one can say whom the Lord will set right.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Nanak: through the Guru, those the Lord enlightens come to understand. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Nanak: having created beings, the Lord installed Dharamraj to write their accounts.
ਓਥੈ. ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ; ਚੁਣਿ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
There, truth alone decides; the wrongdoers are picked out and set apart.
ਥਾਉ. ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ; ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੑੈ. ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
The false find no place there; with blackened faces they are driven to hell.
ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ; ਹਾਰਿ ਗਏ. ਸਿ ਠਗਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
Those imbued with Your Name win; the cheats lose.
Dharamraj was installed to keep the accounts. ॥2॥
Wondrous the sounds, wondrous the Vedas;
wondrous the beings, wondrous their kinds;
wondrous the forms, wondrous the colours;
wondrous the creatures that wander naked.
464: Wondrous is the air, wondrous the water;
wondrous the fires that play their amazing games;
wondrous the earth, wondrous the sources of life;
wondrous how beings cling to the taste of things.
Wondrous is union, wondrous is separation;
wondrous is hunger, wondrous is plenty;
wondrous is His praise, wondrous His glory;
wondrous the wilderness, wondrous the road.
Wondrous that He is near, wondrous that He is far;
wondrous that He watches over all, present everywhere.
Seeing these wonders, I am left in awe.
Nanak: only by great good fortune is this understood. ॥1॥
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਿਸੈ. ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ. ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Your power is all that is seen and all that is heard; Your power is the awe that is the root of all peace.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Your power is in the underworlds and in the skies; Your power is the whole visible world.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਤੇਬਾ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Your power is the Vedas, the Puranas and the Semitic scriptures; Your power is all thought.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Your power is eating, drinking and dressing; Your power is all love.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਰੰਗੀ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
Your power is in castes, kinds and colours; Your power is in the creatures of the world.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨੇਕੀਆ. ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਦੀਆ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Your power is in good deeds and in vices; Your power is in honour and in pride.
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Your power is air, water and fire; Your power is the earth and its dust.
ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ, ਤੂੰ ਕਾਦਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
All is Your power; You are the all-powerful Creator; Your greatness is the purest of the pure.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੋ ਤਾਕੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: keeping all within His command, the Lord watches over it, present through and through. ॥2॥
ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੈ; ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮੜਿ, ਭਉਰੁ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥
The soul enjoys its pleasures, then the body becomes a heap of ash and the soul departs.
ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ; ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ, ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
However great a worldly person becomes, at death a chain is thrown round the neck and he is driven away.
ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਵਾਚੀਐ; ਬਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
Hereafter only the earnings of the Lord's praise are counted; there the account is read out and explained.
ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ. ਪਉਦੀਈ; ਹੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ ॥
The one being struck finds no shelter; who will hear his cries then?
The blind-minded one has wasted this birth. ॥3॥
In His fear the wind always blows;
in His fear flow hundreds of thousands of rivers;
in His fear fire does its labour;
in His fear the earth is pressed down under its load;
ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ; ਇੰਦੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
in His fear the clouds move about, heads bowed;
in His fear stands the court of the Judge of Dharma.
ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ; ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
In His fear is the sun, in His fear the moon;
they travel millions of miles without end.
ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਥ ॥
In His fear are adepts, Buddhas, gods and Naths;
in His fear the skies are stretched out above.
In His fear are warriors and mighty heroes;
in His fear whole multitudes come and go.
On every head the Lord has written fear.
Nanak: only the Formless One, the One True Lord, is without fear. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ; ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Nanak: only the Formless One is without fear; many like Rama are as dust before Him.
ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੰਨੑ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ; ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
So many tales of Krishna, so many reflections on the Vedas — all are as dust.
ਕੇਤੇ ਨਚਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ; ਗਿੜਿ ਮੁੜਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
So many beggars dance, spinning round and keeping time;
ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਮਹਿ; ਆਇ ਕਢਹਿ ਬਾਜਾਰ ॥
the players come into the market and put on their show;
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੀਆ; ਬੋਲਹਿ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲ ॥
dressed as kings and queens they sing and speak all kinds of words;
ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ; ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
they wear earrings worth a fortune and necklaces worth a fortune;
ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥
but, Nanak, the bodies they are worn on turn to ash.
465: ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਗਲੀਈ ਢੂਢੀਐ; ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Wisdom is not found by mere talk; to tell of it is as hard as iron.
ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹੋਰ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
It is received when His grace is given; any other cleverness or command is useless. ॥2॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
If You cast Your glance of grace, then by Your grace the True Guru is found.
ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ; ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
This soul wandered through many births, and then the True Guru let it hear the Word.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
There is no giver as great as the True Guru — listen, all you people.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, those who rid themselves of self have found the True One —
the Guru who gave understanding of the truest of the true. ॥4॥
ਘੜੀਆ, ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ; ਪਹਰ ਕੰਨੑ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
The moments of the day are the milkmaids, the hours are Krishna;
ਗਹਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
air, water and fire are their ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations;
ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ; ਵਰਤਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
the whole earth is the wealth and property of the show, and the world's affairs its props.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਸੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ; ਖਾਇ ਗਇਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the world, without wisdom, is being robbed, and death devours it. ॥1॥
The disciples play the instruments, and the gurus dance;
they shake their feet and roll their heads;
the dust flies up and settles in their hair;
the people watch, laugh, and go home.
For the sake of bread they keep the beat,
and throw themselves down on the ground.
They sing as milkmaids, they sing as Krishna;
they sing as Sita, Rama and kings.
The Fearless, Formless One, whose Name is True,
whose making is the whole world —
His servants serve Him, raised up by His grace;
the night of their life passes sweetly, their minds eager for Him.
Those who learn this teaching through the Guru's wisdom
are carried across by the Gracious One's grace.
The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the hand-mill, the potter's wheel,
the countless whirlwinds of the desert,
spinning tops, churning sticks, threshing frames,
birds that wheel about without pausing for breath,
creatures set spinning on the spit —
Nanak, there is no counting or end of things that spin.
Binding them in bonds, the Lord makes them spin;
each one dances to the deeds already done.
ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਹਸਹਿ; ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
Those who dance and dance and laugh depart weeping in the end.
ਉਡਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੀ; ਸਿਧ. ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ॥
They do not fly up to any high state, nor become adepts.
Dancing and leaping are only the mind's whim;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੨॥
Nanak, those whose minds hold the fear of God — their minds hold love. ॥2॥
ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ. ਨਰਕਿ, ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Your Name is the Formless One; remembering Your Name, one does not go to hell.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ; ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ. ਆਖਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Soul and body are all His; He gives us food — to try to reckon it is a waste.
ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ. ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ ॥
If you want your own good, do good deeds and still call yourself lowly.
ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ; ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਆਈਐ ॥
Even if you try to push old age away, old age comes in its disguise.
When the measure is full, no one stays. ॥5॥
ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾ. ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ; ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
The Muslims praise the sharia; reading and reading it they reflect
ਬੰਦੇ ਸੇ. ਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੰਦੀ; ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
that God's servants are those who bind themselves by it in order to see Him.
ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
The Hindus praise the praiseworthy, the boundless and beautiful, through their shastras;
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ, ਅਰਚਾ ਪੂਜਾ; ਅਗਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਕਾਰੁ ॥
they bathe at holy places, make offerings to idols, and burn sandal and incense.
ਜੋਗੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਨੑਿ ਜੇਤੇ; ਅਲਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
The yogis meditate in the void and call the Creator the Unseen.
466: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
To them He is subtle in form, untouched by Maya, and the whole world is His body.
ਸਤੀਆ. ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ; ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
The charitable feel contentment when they think of giving;
ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ, ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ; ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
but having given, they ask a thousand times more, and the world praises them.
ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ; ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
There are thieves, adulterers, liars, the wicked and the depraved,
ਇਕਿ. ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ; ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
some who use up what they earned before and leave — to them too He has given some task.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ; ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Beings in water and on land, in countless cities, worlds and forms —
ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ. ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ. ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
whatever they say, You know; they too depend on You.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Nanak: the devotees hunger only to praise Him; the True Name is their support.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ. ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
They live in bliss day and night, and count themselves the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ॥1॥
ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ; ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮੑਿਆਰ ॥
The clay of a Muslim's grave may end up in the potter's lump;
ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
he shapes it into pots and bricks, and it cries out as it burns;
ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ; ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
the poor clay weeps as it burns, and embers fall from it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ. ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ. ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: the Creator who made the world — He alone knows. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Without the True Guru no one has found Him; without the True Guru no one has found Him.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ. ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ. ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
He has placed Himself within the True Guru; this I declare openly for all to hear.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, who has rid himself of attachment, one is free for ever.
ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
This is the highest understanding: whoever has fixed his mind on the True One
has found the Giver, the Life of the world. ॥6॥
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
In ego one comes, in ego one goes;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
in ego one is born, in ego one dies;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
in ego one gives, in ego one takes;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
in ego one earns, in ego one loses;
in ego one is truthful or false;
in ego one weighs sin and merit;
in ego one goes to hell or heaven;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
in ego one laughs, in ego one weeps;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
in ego one is soiled, in ego one is washed;
in ego one loses oneself in caste and kind;
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
in ego one is a fool, in ego one is wise;
ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ; ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
and does not understand liberation and release.
ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ; ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
In ego is Maya, in ego is her shadow;
through ego, beings are born again and again.
When ego is understood, then the Lord's door is seen;
without that wisdom, one talks and talks and burns inside.
Nanak: by His command the writ is written;
as one looks on others, so one becomes. ॥1॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
This is the nature of ego: in ego people do their deeds.
ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
These are the bonds of ego, by which they are born again and again.
ਹਉਮੈ. ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ. ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
Where does ego come from? By what discipline does it go?
ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ; ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
Ego exists by His command; people wander according to their past deeds.
ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ; ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Ego is a chronic disease, but its cure is also within it.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
If the Lord shows His grace, one lives by the Guru's Word.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ; ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ. ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak says: listen, people — by this discipline suffering departs. ॥2॥
ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ. ਸੰਤੋਖੀਈਁ; ਜਿਨੑੀ. ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
The contented, who meditate on the truest of the true, are the ones who serve.
467: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ. ਨ ਰਖਿਓ; ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
They do not set foot on evil; they do good and live by dharma.
ਓਨੑੀ. ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ; ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
They break the bonds of the world, and eat and drink little.
ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ; ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ. ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
"You are the great Forgiver; You give every day, and give ever more."
Praising the Great One, they find the Great One. ॥7॥
ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ; ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
Of people, trees, holy places, river banks, clouds, fields,
islands, worlds, realms, continents and universes,
of beings born from eggs, wombs, earth and sweat,
ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
of lakes, mountains and creatures — Nanak, He alone knows the measure.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
Nanak: having created the beings, He takes care of them all.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
The Creator who made the creation also bears its care.
ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
That Creator who made the world looks after it.
ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ. ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
To Him I bow, to Him I give praise; His court lasts for ever.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ. ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak: without the True Name, what use is the forehead mark, what use the sacred thread? ॥1॥
ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ; ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Hundreds of thousands of good and virtuous deeds, hundreds of thousands of approved charities,
ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ; ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
hundreds of thousands of austerities at holy places, yogic trance in the wilderness,
ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ; ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
hundreds of thousands of brave deeds in battle, giving up one's life on the field,
ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ. ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
hundreds of thousands of kinds of focus, wisdom and meditation, readings of the Puranas —
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
the Creator who made the creation has written its coming and going;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, all this cleverness is false; His grace is the true mark. ॥2॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
You alone are the True Master, who has spread out the truest of truths.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ, ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ; ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
The one You give it to receives truth, and then lives by truth.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Meeting the True Guru, they find truth; the Guru has settled truth in their hearts.
ਮੂਰਖ. ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Fools do not know the truth; the self-willed waste their lives.
Why did they even come into the world? ॥8॥
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ; ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
One may read and read until carts are loaded with books, until caravans are filled;
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
read and read until a boat is filled, until pits are packed with books;
ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ; ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
read year after year, read month after month;
ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ; ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
read all one's life, with every breath;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ; ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
Nanak, only one thing counts — His praise; all else is the babble of ego. ॥1॥
The more one writes and reads, the more one burns with pride.
The more one wanders to holy places, the more one talks about it.
ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ; ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
One wears many religious garbs and inflicts pain on the body —
bear it, soul: it is your own doing.
One gives up grain and loses all taste of life;
caught in duality, one suffers greatly.
One wears no clothes and is miserable day and night.
ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ; ॥ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ. ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਸੂਤਾ ॥
Ruined by vows of silence — how can the sleeper wake without the Guru?
One goes barefoot, and suffers for one's own doing.
ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
One eats filth and throws ashes on the head;
the blind fool has lost his honour.
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕਿਛੁ. ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without the Name nothing is accepted.
One lives in the wilderness, among tombs and cremation grounds;
the blind one does not understand, and regrets it later.
468: One who meets the True Guru finds peace,
and enshrines the Lord's Name in the mind.
Nanak: one on whom He casts His grace receives it,
ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ. ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ; ਹਉਮੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
free of hope and anxiety, burning away ego through the Word. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤ. ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ. ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
Your devotees are pleasing to You; singing Your praise, they look beautiful at Your door.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ. ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
Nanak: the unfortunate run about and find no shelter at Your door.
ਇਕਿ. ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨੑਿ, ਆਪਣਾ; ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
Some do not understand their own origin, and count themselves great without cause.
ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ; ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
I am a bard of low caste; others call themselves high-born.
I beg from those who meditate on You. ॥9॥
ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ. ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
False is the king, false the subjects, false the whole world;
ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ. ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
false the pavilions, false the mansions, false those who live in them;
ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ. ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
false is gold, false is silver, false those who wear them;
ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ. ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ; ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
false the body, false the clothes, false the endless beauty;
ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ; ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
false the husband, false the wife, wasting away in grief.
ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ; ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
The false one loves the false, and has forgotten the Creator.
ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
With whom should one make friends? The whole world is passing away.
ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ. ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ; ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
Falsehood is sweet, falsehood is honey; falsehood drowns boatloads.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak makes this prayer: without You all is false. ॥1॥
ਸਚੁ. ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Truth is known only when the True One dwells in the heart;
ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ; ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
then the filth of falsehood is removed, and the body is washed clean.
ਸਚੁ. ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Truth is known only when one loves the True One;
ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ. ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ; ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
hearing the Name, the mind rejoices, and one finds the door of liberation.
ਸਚੁ. ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Truth is known only when one knows the way of life:
ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
preparing the field of the body, one sows the seed of the Creator in it.
ਸਚੁ. ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਸਿਖ. ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
Truth is known only when one takes true teaching,
ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ; ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
shows mercy to living beings, and gives in charity.
ਸਚੁ. ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Truth is known only when one dwells at the pilgrimage place within,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ; ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ. ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
taking counsel from the True Guru, sitting and staying there.
ਸਚੁ. ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ; ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
Truth is the cure for all; it washes away sin.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak makes this prayer to those who hold truth in their hearts. ॥2॥
ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ; ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
The gift I ask is the dust of the saints' feet; if I receive it, I will put it on my forehead.
ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ; ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Give up false greed, and with one mind meditate on the Unseen.
ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
As the work one does, so is the fruit one receives.
ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
If it is so written from the start, one receives the dust of their feet.
Through shallow understanding, service is wasted. ॥10॥
ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ. ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ; ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
Truth is scarce, falsehood prevails; the blackness of this dark age has made people ghosts.
ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ. ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ; ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
Those who sowed the seed left with honour; now how can a split seed sprout?
ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਤ ਉਗਵੈ. ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
If the seed is whole and the season is right, then it sprouts.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਕੋਰੈ. ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Nanak: without a mordant, raw cloth does not take the dye.
ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ. ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ; ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Bleach it in the fear of God, and apply the mordant of honest effort;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ; ਕੂੜੈ. ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, if it is dyed in devotion, falsehood will not come near it. ॥1॥
ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ. ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
Greed is king, sin his minister, falsehood the headman;
ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ. ਪੁਛੀਐ; ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lust is the deputy who is summoned and consulted; he sits and gives counsel.
469: ਅੰਧੀ ਰਯਤਿ. ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ; ਭਾਹਿ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
The blind subjects, without wisdom, pay their dues to the fire of craving.
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਚਹਿ. ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਹਿ; ਰੂਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Those called wise dance, play instruments, and dress up in disguises;
ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਹਿ. ਵਾਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
they shout loudly and sing ballads of war and heroes.
ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ. ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਜਤਿ; ਸੰਜੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Foolish pandits are full of cleverness and argument, and love hoarding wealth.
ਧਰਮੀ. ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਵਹਿ; ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
The pious do their pious deeds but waste them, asking for the door of liberation in return.
ਜਤੀ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ, ਜੁਗਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਛਡਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
Some call themselves celibates without knowing the way, and leave house and home.
ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ; ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ॥
Everyone thinks they are complete; no one says they fall short.
ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ. ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Nanak: one's true weight is known only when honour is placed in the other pan of the scale. ॥2॥
ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Nanak: what the Lord has decreed comes to pass; the True One watches over all.
ਸਭਨੀ ਛਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੀਆ; ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Everyone makes their efforts, but what the Creator does is what happens.
ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ; ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
Hereafter caste and power count for nothing; there one deals with beings who are strangers.
ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ; ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
Only those few are good who receive honour when the account is reckoned. ॥3॥
ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ. ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Those to whom You gave grace from the start are the ones who meditate on the Master.
ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤੁਧੁ. ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Nothing is in the power of these beings; You have made a world of many kinds.
ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਇਕਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Some You unite with Yourself, and some You have led astray.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਜਿਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
The one to whom You give understanding of Yourself knows You through the Guru's grace,
and merges easily in the True One. ॥11॥
ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ. ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ; ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ. ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Hardship becomes the cure and comfort the disease; but when true comfort comes, suffering stays no more.
ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ, ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
You are the Creator who does all things, not I; if I think I can grasp it, it does not hold. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to You, who dwell within Your creation;
ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your limit cannot be found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ. ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Your light is in all creation, and all creation is in Your light; You pervade everything, whole and complete.
ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲੑਿਉ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ. ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
You are the True Master, and Your praises are beautiful; whoever sings them is carried across.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ; ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ, ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Says Nanak: praise the Creator, who does whatever He sees fit to do. ॥2॥
ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ. ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ; ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
The way of the yogi is wisdom; the way of the brahmin is the Vedas;
ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ; ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ; ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
the way of the warrior is bravery; the way of the worker is service to others.
ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ. ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
But the way above all ways is the One; whoever knows this secret —
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
Nanak is that one's servant; that one is the image of the Pure Lord. ॥3॥
ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ. ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ; ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ ॥
The One Lord is the soul of all the gods, the soul of the god of gods.
ਆਤਮਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਸੵਿ; ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Whoever knows the secret of the soul of the all-pervading Lord —
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੪॥
Nanak is that one's servant; that one is the image of the Pure Lord. ॥4॥
ਕੁੰਭੇ ਬਧਾ. ਜਲੁ ਰਹੈ; ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕੁੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Water stays in place when held in a pot, and without water no pot can be made;
ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਬਧਾ. ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
so the mind stays steady when held by wisdom, and without the Guru there is no wisdom. ॥5॥
ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ; ਤਾ ਓਮੀ ਸਾਧੁ. ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
If an educated person is a sinner, the unlettered one who is good is not punished.
ਜੇਹਾ ਘਾਲੇ ਘਾਲਣਾ; ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਨਾਉ ਪਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
As are the deeds one does, so is the name one earns.
ਐਸੀ ਕਲਾ. ਨ ਖੇਡੀਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਇਆ. ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
Do not play a game that makes you lose when you reach the Lord's court.
ਪੜਿਆ ਅਤੈ ਓਮੀਆ; ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
Educated or unlettered, there only reflection on the Lord is counted.
Whoever goes their own way is punished hereafter. ॥12॥
470: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ; ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
Nanak: the human body, the highest of all, has one chariot and one charioteer.
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ; ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
In age after age they change; the wise understand this.
ਸਤਜੁਗਿ. ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ; ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
In the Age of Truth contentment is the chariot, and dharma the charioteer.
ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ; ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
In the Treta Age continence is the chariot, and strength the charioteer.
ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ; ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
In the Dwapar Age austerity is the chariot, and noble conduct the charioteer.
ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ; ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
In this dark age the fire of craving is the chariot, and falsehood the charioteer. ॥1॥
ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ. ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
The Sama Veda says the Master is clothed in white, dwelling in truth, abiding in truth;
The Rig Veda says the Lord pervades everywhere;
among the gods, the name of Rama shines like the sun;
ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ; ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
In the Yajur Veda, the Lord became Krishna of the Yadavs, who beguiled Chandravali by force,
ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ. ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ; ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
brought the Parijat tree for his milkmaid, and revelled in Brindavan.
ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ. ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ; ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
In this dark age the Atharva Veda came to the fore, and the Lord's name became Khuda and Allah;
ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ; ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
the Turks and Pathans took power, dressed in blue robes.
All four Vedas claim to be true;
those who read and study them find four different teachings.
But one who, through loving devotion, calls himself lowly —
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, meeting whom I remember the Master;
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ. ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ; ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
who gave me teaching and the ointment of wisdom, so that with these eyes I see the world as it is.
ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ; ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
Traders who leave the Master and cling to another are drowned.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ; ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
The True Guru is the ship, but only a rare one understands this.
In His grace He has carried me across. ॥13॥
ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ; ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
The silk-cotton tree is straight, very tall and very thick;
ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ; ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
but why do the birds that come to it in hope leave disappointed?
ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ; ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
Its fruit is tasteless, its flowers have no flavour, and its leaves are of no use.
ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
Nanak: sweetness and humility are the essence of all virtue and goodness.
ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ; ਪਰ ਕਉ. ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Everyone bows for their own sake; no one bows for another.
ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ; ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Weigh on the scale, and the pan that sinks is the heavier.
ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ; ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
The sinner bows twice as low, like the hunter stalking the deer;
ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ, ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ; ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
what is gained by bowing the head when the heart is crooked? ॥1॥
The pandit reads his books, says his prayers and argues;
he worships stones and sits in trance like a heron;
he speaks lies and dresses them up as fine ornaments;
he recites the Gayatri three times a day;
a rosary round his neck, a mark on his forehead,
two loincloths, a cloth over his head at prayer.
If he knew the true work of God,
he would know for certain that all these rituals are empty.
Says Nanak: meditate with firm faith;
without the True Guru the way is not found. ॥2॥
ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ; ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Fine clothes and a beautiful form must be left behind in this world when one goes.
ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
One receives the fruit of one's own good and bad deeds.
ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
One who gave orders as he pleased must go ahead by a narrow, hard road.
